about_short_description.short_description: Rilla Network provides peer-to-peer video streaming technology that uses viewer bandwidth to distribute video.

product.name: Live Video Distribution Engine
product.description: An AI-driven video distribution system that optimizes latency, cost, and streaming quality in real-time for live broadcasts.

product.name: Peer-to-Peer Streaming Network
product.description: A network that reduces CDN usage by sharing bandwidth load among viewers, lowering streaming costs by 60-90%.

product.name: Streaming Analytics and Testing Suite
product.description: A toolset providing real-time monitoring, analytics, and testing to maintain streaming performance and resilience.

product.name: Security Features for Streaming
product.description: A set of security measures including DRM, authentication, and P2P-based protections against DDoS attacks for streaming content.

product.name: Native SDKs for Integration
product.description: Performance-optimized software development kits that integrate Rilla's streaming technology into various platforms with minimal complexity.
